ayahs.2: Raat (ke waqt namaz) mein khade ho jao magar kam.
ayahs.3: Aadhi raat ya is se bhi kuchh kam kar le.
ayahs.4: Ya is par badha de aur Quran ko thehar thehar kar (saaf) padha kar.
ayahs.5: Yaqeenan hum tujh par bahut bhaari baat anqareeb naazil karenge.
ayahs.6: Beshak raat ka uthna dil-jami ke liye intehai munaasib hai aur baat ko bahut durust kar dene wala hai.
ayahs.7: Yaqeenan tujhe din mein bahut shughl rehta hai.
ayahs.8: To apne Rabb ke naam ka zikr kiya kar aur tamaam khalaaiq se kat kar us ki taraf mutawajjeh ho ja.
ayahs.9: Mashriq-o-maghrib ka Parwardigaar jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, to usi ko apna kaarsaaz bana le.
ayahs.10: Aur jo kuchh woh kahen tu sehta reh aur wazadaari ke saath un se alag thalag reh.
ayahs.11: Aur mujhe aur un jhutlaane wale aasooda-haal logon ko chhod de aur unhein zara si mohlat de.
ayahs.12: Yaqeenan hamare haan sakht bediyan hain aur sulagti hui jahannam hai.
ayahs.13: Aur halaq mein atakne wala khaana hai aur dard dene wala azaab hai.
ayahs.14: Jis din zameen aur pahaad thartharaa jaayenge aur pahaad misl bhurbhuri ret ke teelon ke ho jaayenge.
ayahs.15: Beshak hum ne tumhari taraf bhi tum par gawaahi dene wala Rasool bhej diya hai jaise ke hum ne Firaun ke paas Rasool bheja tha.
ayahs.16: To Firaun ne is Rasool ki nafarmani ki to hum ne use sakht (wabaal ki) pakad mein pakad liya.
ayahs.17: Tum agar kaafir rahe to us din kaise panaah paoge jo din bachchon ko booda kar dega.
ayahs.18: Jis din aasman phat jaayega, Allah Taala ka yeh waada ho kar hi rehne wala hai.
ayahs.19: Beshak yeh naseehat hai, pas jo chaahe apne Rabb ki taraf raah ikhtiyar kare.
ayahs.20: Aap ka Rabb ba-khoobi jaanta hai ke aap aur aap ke saath ke logon ki ek jamaat qareeb do-tihaai raat ke aur aadhi raat ke aur ek-tihaai raat ke tahajjud padhti hai, aur raat din ka poora andaaza Allah Taala ko hi hai, woh (khoob) jaanta hai ke tum use hargiz na nibha sakoge, pas us ne tum par meharbaani ki, lihaza jitna Quran padhna tumhare liye aasan ho utna hi padho, woh jaanta hai ke tum mein baaz beemar bhi honge, baaz doosre zameen mein chal phir kar Allah Taala ka fazl (yani rozi bhi) talaash karenge aur kuchh log Allah Taala ki raah mein jihad bhi karenge, so tum ba-aasaani jitna Quran padh sako padho aur namaz ki paabandi rakho aur zakat dete raha karo aur Allah Taala ko achha qarz do. Aur jo neki tum apne liye aage bhejoge use Allah Taala ke haan behtar se behtar aur sawaab mein bahut zyada paoge, Allah Taala se maafi maangte raho. Yaqeenan Allah Taala bakhshne wala, meharbaan hai.
